L: Hey everyone, welcome back to my channel.
Today I want to talk about my best friend, Daniel.
We met on the first day of high school, and we've been inseparable ever since.
I was so shy back then that I sat alone at lunch.
Daniel just walked over, sat down, and asked, "Mind if I join you?"
One time, we got completely lost on a hiking trip and ended up laughing for an hour.
Even when things go wrong, he always makes me smile.
He's the kind of friend you can call at any time.
So, thanks for everything, Daniel. See you all next time!
